title: agent-evidence-vectors: conformance vectors for agent execution evidence
description:
Conformance vectors for agent execution evidence, and the reference verifier that judges them. The suite carries eight corpora: the in-toto adversarial-execution-evidence predicate, the in-toto ai-agent-action predicate, SCITT COSE carriage, an anchor-stream verifier, ACS core, an artifact-binding contract, a cross-run record contract, and ACI deployments. One binary judges every one of them, selected by the suite each corpus manifest declares.

The predicate's model is execute-and-attest rather than match-and-assert: a consumer recomputes the outcome from the bytes the statement carries, instead of trusting a verdict the producer asserted about itself. This repository is a second, independently usable implementation of that contract, so that any producer of the predicate type can self-certify and any consumer can reject a lying emitter.

This deposit covers suite revision 29 of the corpus: 275 vectors, of which 61 accept, 212 reject and 2 are indeterminate, exercised by rails in two languages. The bytes are fixed by the corpus digest 0546242b7f42a478d1979c2f86f872b68239ec4f4ff7232a56af777fd40fcaaf recorded in vectors/MANIFEST.json, which tells this deposit from any other revision without anyone recounting it. The corpus is versioned and immutable per revision. A published revision is never mutated in place; a normative change to the predicate, or an addition to the corpus, bumps the revision and regenerates every vector byte-identically from its generators, because the vendored specification's digest is itself a corpus input.

The intended use is citation by a conformance requirement. A requirement that names this suite, or any other suite demonstrated to exercise the same conditions, is checkable by a party who trusts neither the producer nor the implementer.
